name: IJM
recent: IJM 近期获得 AT&S 颁发价值 RM1.23 bil 的合约，在吉打 Kulim 建设半导体制造设施。同时，EPF 与 KWAP 等主要股东持续有股权变动申报，公司也出现董事与委员会成员调整。最新季度营收同比增长 32.2%，净利同比增长 38.4%。
notable: IJM 获得 AT&S 颁发价值 RM1.23 bil 的合约，在吉打 Kulim 建设半导体制造设施。
公司出现董事会及提名与薪酬委员会、审计委员会成员变动。
EPF 与 KWAP 在近期多日申报股权变动。
risks: 公司内部人士（Chief Human Resources）在闭窗期外进行股份交易，并申报在闭窗期内的交易意向。
主要股东 EPF 近期多次申报股权变动，持股比例可能发生变化。
earnings: 最新季度（2026-06-30）营收为 RM2,292.3 mil，同比增长 32.2%，环比增长 22.8%；净利为 RM148.4 mil，同比增长 38.4%，净利率为 6.5%。

recent_en: IJM recently secured a RM1.23 bil contract from AT&S to build semiconductor manufacturing facilities in Kulim, Kedah. Meanwhile, major shareholders such as EPF and KWAP continued to file changes in shareholdings, and there were board and committee changes. Latest quarter revenue rose 32.2% yoy and net profit grew 38.4% yoy.
notable_en: IJM secured a RM1.23 bil contract from AT&S to build semiconductor manufacturing facilities in Kulim, Kedah.
There were changes in the board and members of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Audit Committee.
EPF and KWAP filed changes in shareholdings on multiple recent dates.
risks_en: An internal insider (Chief Human Resources) dealt in shares outside the closed period and declared an intention to deal during the closed period.
Major shareholder EPF filed multiple changes in shareholdings recently, and its stake may have changed.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter (2026-06-30), revenue was RM2,292.3 mil, up 32.2% yoy and 22.8% qoq; net profit was RM148.4 mil, up 38.4% yoy, with a net margin of 6.5%.
